ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.
   B. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam .
   C. Use Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   B. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapters 90:1.
   B. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Chapters 90:1 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat and Zakatul Fitr has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)
   A. Use Significance of Tawhid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Tawhid.
   C. Say Significance of Tawhid has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Significance of Tawhid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
   C. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

12. Which response best shows understanding of Shirk of Shirk Shirk? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Shirk of Shirk Shirk to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Shirk of Shirk Shirk has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shirk of Shirk Shirk.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Marriage marriage for marriage responsibilitie s of husband and wife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Trade and Finance in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary issues 08 7 Islamic Heritage and Civilisation 7.1 Reforms introduce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary issues Women in Islam Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
